title: Smooth Crystals Deluxe
description: Smooth Crystals Deluxe is a PvP resource pack that simplifies crystal textures for cleaner visibility and easier tracking in combat.
body: Smooth Crystals Deluxe is a Crystal PvP-focused resource pack designed to reduce visual clutter and improve clarity during fights. It replaces detailed end crystal textures with a smoother, more readable design while keeping a clean and polished look. Perfect for competitive PvP where fast reaction time and clear visuals matter most.
